note: This card models Daytona's Windows VM sandbox product line, part of the same company/product as the Linux 'daytona' card. Daytona Platforms, Inc. was founded by Ivan Burazin and Vedran Jukic (previously PHPanywhere/Codeanywhere). Not a YC company (ycombinator.com/companies/daytona returns 404); no accelerator/incubator found. Funding history: $2M pre-seed (Nov 2023, angels + 500 Global/Tiny.vc/Silicon Gardens/Darkmode VC/Firestreak), $5M seed led by Upfront Ventures (Jun 2024), $24M Series A led by FirstMark Capital (Feb 2026) with Datadog and Figma Ventures as strategic investors. In June 2026 Daytona announced it is moving its sandbox codebase from open source (AGPL-3.0) to closed source for security reasons; the old daytonaio/daytona GitHub repo is frozen/unmaintained.
